-- Stock levels kept in an insertion-ordered Map.
type StockError = OutOfStock | UnknownItem | InvalidQty

fn add_stock(stock: Map<Text, Int>, item: Text, qty: Int) -> Map<Text, Int>
  intent "افزودن موجودی به یک کالا؛ اگر کالا نبود با همین مقدار ساخته می‌شود"
  requires qty > 0
  ensures map.get(out, item) == some(option.unwrap_or(map.get(stock, item), 0) + qty)
  example add_stock(map.empty(), "pen", 3) == map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 3)
  example map.get(add_stock(map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 2), "pen", 3), "pen") == some(5)
do
  let current = option.unwrap_or(map.get(stock, item), 0)
  return map.set(stock, item, current + qty)
end fn

fn remove_stock(stock: Map<Text, Int>, item: Text, qty: Int) -> Result<Map<Text, Int>, StockError>
  intent "برداشتن موجودی؛ اگر کالا ناشناس یا موجودی ناکافی باشد خطا می‌دهد"
  example remove_stock(map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 5), "pen", 2) == ok(map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 3))
  example remove_stock(map.empty(), "pen", 1) == err(UnknownItem)
  example remove_stock(map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 1), "pen", 2) == err(OutOfStock)
  example remove_stock(map.set(map.empty(), "pen", 1), "pen", 0) == err(InvalidQty)
do
  if qty <= 0 then
    return err(InvalidQty)
  end if
  match map.get(stock, item) do
    case none =>
      return err(UnknownItem)
    case some(have) =>
      if have < qty then
        return err(OutOfStock)
      end if
      return ok(map.set(stock, item, have - qty))
  end match
end fn

fn double(n: Int) -> Int
  example double(4) == 8
do
  return n * 2
end fn

fn total_units(stock: Map<Text, Int>) -> Int
  intent "جمع همه موجودی‌ها"
  example total_units(map.set(map.set(map.empty(), "a", 2), "b", 5)) == 7
  example total_units(map.empty()) == 0
do
  return list.sum(map.values(stock))
end fn

fn doubled_values(stock: Map<Text, Int>) -> List<Int>
  example doubled_values(map.set(map.empty(), "a", 2)) == [4]
do
  return list.map(map.values(stock), double)
end fn

fn lower_stock_keys(stock: Map<Text, Int>) -> List<Text>
  example lower_stock_keys(map.set(map.set(map.empty(), "b", 1), "a", 2)) == ["b", "a"]
do
  return map.keys(stock)
end fn
